detail.longDescription: Enterprise agents took a restricted action 3.5% of the time when records said no, and 10.3% when the deciding record was missing. DEPUTYBENCH (Zhao and Lin, Nov 9): six models, 27 matched tasks, a secondary analysis. 61 of 100 masked-evidence executions sat in four privacy tasks needing complete counts or per-person consent. Most permission tests flip allow to deny. Does yours ever delete the record? https:// arxiv.org/abs/2611.13355 # AIAgents # Cybersecurity # LLM
